meta.description: Who we are, what we do and which logistics companies we work with.

header.title: Technology and data
header.lede: We are not a logistics company: we are the technology partner that gives yours visibility and data.

story.title: What we do
body: Intello offers cargo monitoring and business intelligence to logistics companies, together with technology and back office services.
We do not transport or store cargo: we monitor the cargo your company moves and turn its data into information to decide better.

steps.title: We talk
steps.body: We learn your operation and your data.

steps.title: We connect
steps.body: We integrate your systems and data sources.

steps.title: We monitor
steps.body: We follow your shipments and collect their data.

steps.title: We improve
steps.body: We measure and adjust with your indicators.
